sentences.en: I think you'd better take a rest; you look ill.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你最好休息一下；你看上去病了。

sentences.en: I'm feeling ill, but I intend to go out anyhow.
sentences.zh: 我感觉不舒服，不过我还是打算出去。

sentences.en: We must not speak ill of others behind their backs.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该在别人背后说他们的坏话。
